actual: Current workflow has one branch-protection gate but duplicates nine standard control IDs across rules and manual controls, leaves nine manual controls without an explicit failure effect, represents seventeen enabled test plans as runner-disabled, and treats failure-evidence publishing as a CI verdict dependency. Normalize block/warn/advisory phase semantics, preserve safety controls, decouple best-effort evidence publishing, and keep changed-file validation minimal.
closure_requirements: Keep BUG JSON and GitHub Issue synchronized.

events.note: Expanded to the exact CI verdict, standard taxonomy, validation plan catalog, loaders, and direct contract tests required by the user-approved workflow gate consolidation.
Removed backend runtime service edits after changed-file inference correctly exposed an unnecessary backend restart contract; execution-mode integrity stays in the existing workflow CLI wrapper.
Removed CLI source edits as well: existing CI contract tests can enforce taxonomy and execution-mode consistency without introducing unknown runtime impact or overlapping BUG-1009 workflow source.

expected: Only selected deterministic quality and test lanes determine CI verdict; evidence publishing is best-effort, every standard control ID has one explicit effect/phase record, and every non-runner validation plan declares its execution owner.
non_goals: Do not start, stop, or restart any user backend without explicit per-target approval.
